## **Sinclair Announces Retirement of Bill Fanshawe Following More Than 30 Years with the Company**


11.16.2026


**BALTIMORE – November 16, 2026** – Sinclair, Inc. today announced that Bill Fanshawe, Senior Vice President, Group Manager and General Manager of WBFF in Baltimore, will retire effective December 31, 2026, concluding more than three decades with the company and nearly 40 years in the broadcast television industry.


Throughout his tenure, Fanshawe has played an integral role in Sinclair's growth and success, leading the company's flagship Baltimore station, WBFF, while overseeing television operations in multiple markets across the country. He has also been instrumental in mentoring and developing station leadership, helping shape the careers of many of Sinclair's current and former General Managers.


“Bill has been an important part of Sinclair’s success for more than 30 years, and his contributions extend well beyond the stations and markets he has led,” said Rob Weisbord, Chief Operating Officer and President of Local Media. “He has been a trusted leader, a mentor to countless colleagues, and a tremendous advocate for local broadcasting. Bill’s deep understanding of our business, commitment to developing talent and longstanding relationships throughout the company have made a lasting impact on Sinclair. His leadership and influence will continue to be felt for years to come through the many people he has guided, mentored, and worked alongside. We are incredibly grateful for his leadership, dedication, and friendship, and wish him all the best in this next chapter.”


Fanshawe joined Sinclair in 1995 in sales management at WNUV in Baltimore and was named General Manager of WBFF and WNUV in 1998. In 2001, he assumed expanded responsibilities as Senior Vice President and Group Manager while continuing to lead WBFF. Over the next 25 years, he provided operational and strategic oversight for numerous Sinclair television markets, including Baltimore, Washington, D.C., Asheville, Columbus, Cincinnati, and Providence.


Prior to joining Sinclair, Fanshawe held sales and management positions at WBBM in Chicago, CBS Spot Television and MMT Sales. He holds a Master of Business Administration from Fairleigh Dickinson University.


“As I reflect on my career and prepare for retirement, I am grateful for the friendships, mentorships, opportunities and experiences that have shaped both my professional and personal journey,” said Fanshawe. “The people of Sinclair and the Smith family have played an important role in that journey, and I will always cherish the relationships and memories built along the way.”


**About Sinclair**


Sinclair, Inc. (Nasdaq: SBGI) is a diversified media company and a leading provider of local news and sports. The Company owns, operates and/or provides services to 181 television stations in 79 markets affiliated with all major broadcast networks; owns Tennis Channel, the premium destination for tennis enthusiasts; and multicast networks CHARGE, Comet, ROAR, and The Nest.
